description: Abstract class 'MaterialsProvider' implementing 'MaterialsProviderInterface' for AWS SDK's cryptography module. It defines support for key sizes, encryption/decryption methods for content encryption keys, and utility functions for generating cryptographic materials.

classes.name: MaterialsProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class providing methods and structure for different materials providers used in AWS SDK encryption.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size (in bits) is supported by AES, based on predefined supported sizes.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the provider based on metadata envelope for decryption purposes.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a description of the cryptographic materials used, for verification.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the name of the wrapping algorithm used by the provider.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to encrypt a content encryption key with provider-specific logic.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt an encrypted content encryption key.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a random content encryption key of specified size in bits.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates a random initialization vector for a given OpenSSL cipher name.
